binary_lsh_sweep_evaluation.source: synthetic 4-class multipath fixture seed 8080; not Kaggle neural embeddings

algebra_composition_evaluation.atomic_training_range: [-10,10], 21 numbers x 4 operations x 2 singleton positions
algebra_composition_evaluation.interpretation: Toy affine function composition; HDC memorizes task programs, not arithmetic. Compare HDC against nearest-key exact map. No Kaggle neural embeddings or general reasoning claim.

dynamic_composition_evaluation.interpretation: No composed programs are stored; task provides step IDs and an explicit executor applies learned affine rules. HDC only superposes and recovers the provided step list. Compare to exact list and independent codeword baselines; this does not show rule discovery or unique HDC advantage.

hdc_capacity_evaluation.interpretation: Stress test: fixed 1024-byte bundle does not imply arbitrarily recoverable depth. Query supplies operation IDs and executor is given. Compare to equal-budget 1024-byte repetition ECC, unbundled codeword per step and uncorrupted byte list. No semantic planning is evaluated.
